What We Do

Every garment,
perfectly fitted

01

Formalwear & Bridal

Wedding gowns, bridesmaids dresses, suits, and formal attire altered with the precision they deserve. We handle corsets, bustles, hems, and full restyling.

Get a quote →
02

Suit Tailoring

Jacket sleeves, chest suppression, trouser tapering, and collar adjustments. Off-the-rack suits transformed into custom fits.

Get a quote →
03

Prom

Prom season is your moment — we'll make sure your dress or suit fits perfectly. Alterations, hemming, and last-minute fixes handled with care and speed.

Get a quote →
04

Dry Cleaning

Professional dry cleaning for suits, gowns, delicate fabrics, and everyday wear. Brought back fresh, pressed, and ready to wear.

Get a quote →
05

Hemming

Pants, skirts, dresses, and coats hemmed to the exact length you need. Blind hems, cuffed hems, and original-hem preservation available.

Get a quote →
06

Resizing & Alterations

Taking in or letting out — waists, seats, shoulders, and sleeves. We adjust fit across the whole garment so it looks made for you.

Get a quote →
07

Zipper & Repairs

Broken zippers replaced, seams re-sewn, buttons reattached, and linings repaired. No job too small — we restore what others can't.

Get a quote →
08

Leather Work

Leather jackets, belts, bags, and accessories altered or repaired. Specialized stitching and hardware replacement handled with care.

Get a quote →

Honest Pricing

We quote before we touch your garment. No surprises, no hidden fees. Just straightforward pricing from people who respect your budget.

See starting prices →

Expert Hands

With over 20 years of tailoring experience, our family-run studio has fitted thousands of garments across the region. We take pride in every single stitch.

See our work →

Guaranteed Fit

Not satisfied with the fit? Come back within 30 days and we'll make it right at no charge. Your satisfaction is our guarantee.

Common Questions

Everything you need
to know

Most standard alterations — hems, taking in, letting out — are ready in 3 to 5 business days. Bridal and complex garments may take 1 to 2 weeks depending on the work involved. Rush service is available; just mention it when you drop off and we'll do our best to accommodate.

Walk-ins are always welcome — no appointment needed for a quick drop-off or a free fitting assessment. That said, if you have a bridal gown or a complex project, booking ahead ensures we have dedicated time for you.

Bring the garment you'd like altered and, where possible, the shoes and undergarments you plan to wear with it. This is especially important for bridal gowns and formal wear — the right foundation changes the fit entirely.

Every garment is different, so we quote before we touch anything — no surprises. You can see our starting prices on this page for common services. For bridal, custom suits, or multi-step alterations, the final price depends on the complexity of the work. The consultation is always free.

Yes. We regularly work with leather jackets, lace bridal overlays, chiffon, silk, and beaded fabrics. These materials require specialized handling and stitching, and we have the equipment and experience to do them properly.

If you're not completely satisfied with the fit after pickup, bring the garment back within 30 days and we'll correct it at no charge. No questions asked. A great fit is the only outcome we'll accept.

Yes — we offer dry cleaning as an add-on to many of our alteration services. Drop your garment with us and we'll take care of both the cleaning and the alteration, so everything is done together before your event.
